examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Root with only a raw `<input>` as its single child.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: The three sizes stacked (`small`=28px, `medium`=32px, `large`=40px). Match the same `size` on child input controls to keep the inner content vertically centered.

examples.name: WithAddonLeft
examples.summary: `<InputGroupAddon>` before the middle input — static-text island on the left.

examples.name: WithAddonRight
examples.summary: `<InputGroupAddon>` after the middle input — static-text island on the right.

examples.name: BothAddons
examples.summary: Addons on both sides flanking the input — `https://…​.com` composition.

examples.name: WithButton
examples.summary: `<Button>` as a direct child on the right. The Button keeps its own API (`label`, `kind`, `size`, `@click`) — the group only joins the border/seam.

examples.name: WithSelect
examples.summary: `<Select>` as a direct child on the left. The Select composition (`Trigger` + `Content` + `Option`) is unchanged — the group only joins the border/seam.

examples.name: WithAll
examples.summary: Addon + input + Button in a single row. Seams are drawn between adjacent children; only the outer edges are rounded.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.summary: Invalid state — root shows the danger border.

examples.name: Required
examples.summary: Required state — root shows the warning border.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled state — muted fill, not-allowed cursor, focus-within ring suppressed. Note: the consumer must also set `disabled` on their middle `<input>` and on each child control; InputGroup does not propagate it.
